objective: Plan dual RTX 3090 (~42-44GB usable) homelab serving of Qwen3.8-27B for multiple Hermes Agent profiles on ONE OpenAI-compatible endpoint with ~256K context, continuous batching, full-GPU weights, open-source stack, reliable tool calling.
summary: WINNER: SGLang TP=2 with cyankiwi AWQ-INT4 weights + fp8_e4m3 KV for multi-Hermes continuous batching and ~245k–256k class context. 0xSero's validated dual-3090 container is the best Phase-1 throughput recipe (~113 tok/s decode) but only ~64k max context with BF16 KV (~119k token pool)—extend it with fp8 KV for the 256k goal. Fallback A: llama.cpp AD-Q4/Q5 + q4_0 KV + MTP for true 262144 single-stream. Fallback B: vLLM TP2 continuous batch. Reject EXL3 as day-1 multi-tenant (batch-1 queue). Ampere rule: AWQ-INT4 Marlin beats FP8 weight compute; FP8 remains useful for KV. Hermes: --tool-call-parser qwen3_coder --reasoning-parser qwen3; enable_thinking false for stable tools.

claims.statement: 0xSero SGLang TP=2 on 2x3090 with AWQ-INT4 delivers ~112.9 tok/s single-stream decode at 8k, ~1480 prefill class, max context 64k with BF16 KV pool ~118693 tokens.
On Ampere sm_86, AWQ INT4 W4A16 Marlin is preferred over FP8 weight formats for decode speed because there are no FP8 tensor cores; FP8 mainly saves memory with dequant overhead.
llama.cpp --cache-type-k/v q4_0 enables full ~262k context beside Q4-class weights on 24GB-class cards (~22.2GB cited); without KV quant context fails past ~90k.
llama.cpp draft-mtp speculative decoding is primarily a single-stream optimization; advantage is largely gone by --parallel 4.
Community dual RTX 3090 SGLang launch has demonstrated --context-length 245760 with cyankiwi AWQ-INT4, TP=2, and --kv-cache-dtype fp8_e4m3 plus qwen3_coder/qwen3 parsers.
MiaAI EXL3+DFlash2/MTP path serves OpenAI API and can target 262k on 24GB with Hadamard-4 KV on Ampere, but generation is batch-1 (concurrent requests queue).

For Hermes/Qwen3.x local serve, use tool-call-parser qwen3_coder and reasoning-parser qwen3; empty content can occur with thinking/reasoning-parser interactions—disable enable_thinking for tool-heavy loops or raise max_tokens.
For multiple Hermes profiles on one endpoint, SGLang or vLLM continuous batching matches goals better than llama.cpp parallel slots or EXL3 batch-1.
Operator bookmark of ~1.2M token capacity should not be read as measured 2x3090 BF16 KV capacity; 0xSero TP2 measured ~119k BF16 pool (larger pools appear on higher TP or fp8 KV configs).
AtomicChat AD-Q4_K_M is ~17.12GB; AD-Q5_K_M ~20.23GB; AD-Q6_K ~25.01GB; Q8_0 ~28.89GB.
vLLM can serve long Qwen3.8-27B contexts on 3090-class hardware (syv-ai single-3090 150k-245k kits; TIANWENtianw 4x3090 FP8 max-model-len 262144 with NCCL_P2P_DISABLE).
